description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Password' that extends 'AbstractRule' and implements password validation logic within a user credential system for the OrangeHRM project. It utilizes traits for text helper functions and password strength services, and performs password policy checks using external service classes.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: A validation rule class for enforcing password policies within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Initializes the Password validation rule, optionally set to skip password change validation.

methods.description: Validates the provided input as a password against password strength and policy rules.
